model.name: QB-retaining Sunday-to-Tuesday market Ridge with injured-reserve starters
added_features: ir_starters_diff: home minus away count of non-QB starters on regular injured reserve (designated-to-return not counted), read from each team's latest roster before the Tuesday prediction; a starter played 50% or more of offensive or defensive snaps in any of his last three games, or averaged 50% or more last season if he has not played this season
market_features: Sunday 11:20 p.m. ET to Tuesday spread movement
Sunday 11:20 p.m. ET to Tuesday total movement

historical.evaluation: 2021-2025 chronological walk-forward; Tuesday US median selects HIGH; graded at best captured US Tuesday quote

interpretation: This is a historical walk-forward research result, not a guarantee of future returns. The gain depends on the 50% starter snap-share cutoff: the other cutoffs tested (30%, 40%, 60%, 70%) produced Wilson lower bounds of 0.5217 to 0.5303 against 0.5417 at 50%.
